Marissa — quick read and answers below: 

- Proposed UK addendum clause: it aligns with our current UK IDTA posture but needs a small tweak to the subcontractor notification window (we usually offer 30 days notice, not 45). I attached a one-paragraph edit and a short rationale (see proposed_uk_addendum_clause.docx).
- Evidence cadence: we can offer SOC 2 report annual delivery and snapshot access to certification artifacts via the Drive link. We should avoid sharing raw penetration-test reports; instead provide an executive summary + remediation ledger.

On the telemetry question: if aggregated metrics contain host identifiers that would allow re-identification across tenants when combined with other datasets, that could trigger a need for a focused TIA. Elena / team — following up with the technical readout. Short answer: we do not currently join telemetry aggregates with PII and host identifiers are hashed and scoped per-customer. That said, the analytics vendor in the US receives an aggregated payload that includes coarse region tags.

Mitigations we can offer to Globex: 
- Option A (preferred): configure Globex tenant to keep observability buffers and analytics routing within EU/UK regions (no cross-border telemetry). This is a configuration change and has a small cost delta.
- Option B: keep current routing but add contractual constraints + pseudonymization guarantees and a quarterly technical attestation (summary of retention and access controls).

I'll add a brief technical appendix to the Drive link describing hashing/salting approach and retention windows. Laura — please upload the appendix and mark it as Tech Appendix: Telemetry Controls.

Elena — next steps from our side: 1) accept the proposed UK Addendum edits from Karthik or flag changes, 2) pick mitigation Option A or B for telemetry, 3) confirm preferred evidence package (SOC2 exec summary + Tech Appendix). Once you confirm, Marissa will circulate the final DPA + UK Addendum for signature.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference
